Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 13  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in interpreting the release year data by incorrectly accepting the title "Dilan 1991" as an indication of a 1991 release year, despite clear evidence to the contrary. The WebSurfer's report indicated that "Dilan 1991" was released in 2019, but the Planner misinterpreted this as 1991 due to the title and erroneously concluded that it was released before "Celine: Through The Eyes Of The World." This error exemplifies a pattern seen in example 1, where the planner misinterprets context from a title, leading to an incorrect chronological order of release dates.
